description: This Java source file defines the NotificationSenderService class, which manages the process of sending notifications via GCM (Google Cloud Messaging). It handles grouping SMS messages by client, creates notifications, and sends them using a Sender object. It also updates message statuses based on the result.

classes.name: NotificationSenderService
classes.description: Service responsible for sending notifications to clients via GCM, handling message grouping, creation, sending, and status updates.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Main method that accepts a list of SMS messages, groups them by client, and sends notifications to each client's device.

methods.name: getNotificationListByClient
methods.description: Utility method to organize SMS messages into a map keyed by client ID to facilitate batch notifications.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends individual notifications to a specific client based on their device registration, updating message statuses accordingly.
